synthetic_auxiliary_ablation.description: Scaled synthetic counterpart of the CodeContests/TinyLlama ablation from Table 2: meaningful auxiliary variables increase accepted teacher-verified tokens compared with an independent multi-token predictor of the same size. Scores come from the hidden test (evaluator-held control batch of 16,384 blocks, evaluator-owned teacher and one-call proposer family).
synthetic_auxiliary_ablation.notes: Scaled setup: hand-authored order-two 16-token teacher, no context, 32-token horizon, 343,600-parameter proposers trained from scratch for the paper's 150k steps (batch 512, the gym's training budget of 76.8M sequence passes), instead of TinyLlama on CodeContests with 16-token proposals. The paper's Table 2 numbers are not on this scale and are kept under _paper_results. Model size is a hard eligibility gate (measured parameters <= 1.10x the 343,600-parameter independent baseline, else the run scores as failed), not a ranked metric; the training budget is a documented contract rule (see scoring/CONSTRAINTS.md).

avg_accepted_tokens.description: Mean teacher-verified accepted prefix length for the full proposal horizon.

avg_correct_tokens.description: Mean number of initially correct proposed tokens before the first mismatch.

token_accuracy.description: All-position token accuracy, catching methods that optimize only the earliest accepted prefix.

tail_token_accuracy.description: Second-half token accuracy, checking that proposal quality persists beyond the easiest early positions.

prefix8_success_rate.description: Fraction of examples whose first eight proposed tokens all match the teacher.

_paper_results.source: Parallel Token Prediction (arXiv 2512.21323), Table 2: CodeContests, TinyLlama-1.1B teacher, 16 proposed tokens with context. avg_correct_tokens derived as #accepted - 1 (App. C, sequential correction).
_paper_results.scale_note: Not on this experiment's scale: the gym proposes 32 tokens without context from a synthetic order-two teacher, so its accepted-prefix lengths are not comparable in magnitude to Table 2's 16-token CodeContests numbers. Only the direction (O-PTP above independent prediction at equal size) carries over. The paper's numbers are kept here unchanged rather than as results the gym must match.

synthetic_auxiliary_ablation._results_note: results holds this gym's own measured reference values (hidden test, scoring/scores_test.json, reference O-PTP and independent baseline trained to the 150k-step budget), not paper numbers; the paper's Table 2 numbers are under _paper_results.

synthetic_restricted_compute_n8.description: Scaled synthetic counterpart of the taxi restricted-compute ablation from Table 10 at proposal length N=8: auxiliary-conditioned O-PTP should keep longer correct prefixes than independent prediction at the same model scale. Reference values are the paper's Table 10 numbers; reproduced scores come from the hidden test (first 8 positions of the same evaluator-run proposals).
synthetic_restricted_compute_n8.notes: The paper reports average correct tokens for this restricted setting (Table 10, taxi data, 29M-parameter GPT-2 teacher); those numbers share this experiment's 8-token scale. avg_accepted_tokens is derived as min(avg_correct_tokens + 1, 8) and is not a paper-reported number. Scaled setup as in synthetic_auxiliary_ablation. Model size is a hard eligibility gate, not a ranked metric.

avg_correct_tokens.description: Mean number of initially correct proposed tokens before the first mismatch under the eight-token horizon.

avg_accepted_tokens.description: Mean teacher-verified accepted prefix length under the eight-token horizon.

token_accuracy.description: All-position token accuracy over the eight-token restricted horizon.

tail_token_accuracy.description: Accuracy on positions four through seven, guarding against methods tuned only to the first few restricted tokens.

prefix8_success_rate.description: Fraction of restricted-horizon examples with all eight tokens correct.
